messages:
Elena - People Ops: Quick check  cohort A arriving Mon 9:00am at SF office. Need parking passes, shuttle pickup from 8:20, accessible seating in Conf B, breakfast headcount, and a laptop pickup slot around 9:15. Also one hire still has pending BG check and passport delayed for I-9  any safe workaround? @Jordan @Mike
Mike - Facilities: We have 3 parking passes left for that day. Can reserve. Shuttle confirmed 8:20 from Civic Center lot. Need the names.
Jordan - IT: Laptop imaging slots open at 9:10 or 9:40. Keycards: new cohort needs escort to badge station. @Elena send list of emails and device types (mac/win).
Elena - People Ops: I have 6 names now. I'll DM emails and device types in a sec. For the passport delay  they'll have it by day 4. Can we let them start and complete I-9 later?
Ashley - People Ops: We can provisionally onboard but I-9 must be done by Day 3 per federal rules. If passport is delayed, sometimes we accept a combination of other documents or use our notary exception  leaning on Legal on this.
LegalBot: Reminder: I-9 completion required within 3 business days. Notary/remote exceptions allowed only with prior legal approval. Please send the hire's situation and expected receipt date to compliance@redwood.com.
Elena - People Ops: Thanks  will send compliance the note right away. Breakfast: 10 people total. Can we do vegan + gluten-free options? Also flag Conf B for wheelchair access.
Mike - Facilities: Conf B is accessible. Catering will include GF and vegan options. Any allergies?
Elena - People Ops: One nut allergy; rest are standard.
Jordan - IT: Escort plan  can we assign Nikhil and Priya to escort and badge handoff? Also imaging command for reference: `redwood-setup --image cohortA` (run on arrival).
Nikhil: I can escort the cohort. I'll be at the lobby at 8:55.
Priya: I'll handle keycard handouts and badge photos. If anyone's late, security will hold badges until 10:30.
Elena - People Ops: :thumbsup: perfect. I've submitted the parking list to Mike. I'll also DM compliance the BG/I-9 exception info. Anything else?
Mike - Facilities: Parking passes emailed to you.
PeopleOpsBot: Action item created: onboarding-cohortA-checklist (#12345). Due: 2026-04-01.
Jordan - IT: One more thing  do any new hires need HDMI adapters or dongles? We have a small stock; tell me if someone requires one.
Adele: Quick q from a new hire  where do we pick up the badge if we arrive late?
Priya: If late, meet security desk and ask for "Cohort A check-in"; they'll hold badges until 10:30 then return to security.
Elena - People Ops: Calendar invites updated and RSVP sent. I'll close the loop after compliance confirms the I-9 plan. Thanks everyone!
